title: Malicious code in w-mousekey (npm)
description: The w-mousekey npm package versions 1.0.41 and 1.0.42 contain malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. This compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different, secure device. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by it.
